completion_decisions: Use paper Eqs. (1)-(6) for the Gaussian wake, atmospheric log law, rotor average, and linear local-inlet deficit superposition.
Use paper Eqs. (21)-(26) for the stationary Markov wind distribution, thresholded intermittency, mean power, square boundary, and greater-than-3D spacing.
Use paper Eqs. (27)-(28) and Section 3.3 for real-coded NSGA-III with population 92 and 91 reference intervals.
Reconstruct Figs. 7-9 with nine visible speeds, figure-constrained probabilities, and reversible local Markov kernels that exactly preserve the declared stationary wind rose.
Digitize V112 Fig. 5 curves and use eight deterministic equal-area rotor samples.
Complete Eq. (27) with independent uniform coordinate mixing and Eq. (28) with Deb polynomial mutation index 20; use deterministic repair.
Freeze the paper-visible 1000-generation scale because the hypervolume reference and history rule are absent; use 25 platform seeds.
Implement all six real-scale optimization cases and retain the three-turbine model problem as an H5 fixture; comparison methods are excluded.

paper_source_conflicts: Section 3.1 says hourly Korea Meteorological Administration data measured at Marado from 2002 through 2022 were used, while the Data availability statement says no data were used.

scope.claim_boundary: academic flexible paper-equation and figure-constrained reconstruction of NSGA-III and all six paper cases; not author source original Marado data private arrays random states or numerical replay

constraints_and_repair.resolution: coordinates in [0,20D] square, pair spacing greater than 3D, deterministic clamp and rejection repair with feasible lattice fallback

decision_variables.resolution: continuous x-y coordinates for 25 Vestas V112 turbines

encoding_and_decoder.resolution: real 2-by-25 coordinate chromosome with turbine index retained through crossover mutation and repair

initialization.resolution: paper checkerboard reference plus counter-keyed uniform feasible layouts and deterministic repair

metrics_and_repeats.resolution: front maximum mean power and minimum intermittency, front cardinality, timings, physical FES, science hashes, and 25 seeds per case

objective_and_direction.resolution: minimize reciprocal stationary mean power and thresholded expected absolute Markov power transition

paper_native_cases.resolution: uniform and real wind crossed with 0 7 and 15 percent thresholds; three-turbine model retained as physics fixture

parameters.resolution: population 92, 91 reference intervals, crossover probability 1, coordinate mutation probability 1/50, polynomial index 20, and 1000 formal generations

stopping_and_physical_fes.resolution: 92 initial plus 1000 offspring populations equals 92092 complete-layout evaluations; dynamic hypervolume stop is not claimed because its reference and history rule are missing

training_and_inference_lifecycle.resolution: not applicable; NSGA-III has no learned model

update_order.resolution: rank, uniform elementwise crossover, bounded polynomial mutation, repair, evaluate, parent-offspring merge, and reference-line niching

wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.resolution: three-dimensional Gaussian wake with k*=0.0256, log-law shear z0=0.0001 m, local-inlet linear deficit superposition, eight-point rotor average, and digitized V112 curves

wind_and_scenario_sampling.resolution: nine speeds by sixteen directions; uniform or figure-constrained real stationary rose with reversible local Markov transitions at 24.8-degree directional scale
